audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1-3 and Levels 4-5 rows are marked side=Draven while content win[0..3] already say Sivir, and Level 6/First item are marked side=Skill while win[4]/win[5] say Draven; the full-layer why text also argues the wrong direction on rows 4-5.
audit.why: Content layer (win[] and whys[]) already matches the packet levelChart (Sivir,Sivir,Sivir,Sivir,Draven,Draven,Sivir); full layer disagreed on 6 of 7 rows.
audit.corrected: Full phases[].side realigned to match win[]: rows 0-3 -> Sivir, rows 4-5 -> Draven, row 6 -> Sivir, with why text rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.why: Content spikes[] already correctly identify level 6 (Whirling Death execute + axe all-in) and first item (axe+lethality burst, Blood Rush kiting) as Draven's power spikes, and late game as Sivir's teamfight spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: No text calls out that Draven's combo opens with the Spinning Axe (Q) auto-attack-reset animation as a readable tell, and breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown numbers.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags the autoreset-burst-tell as applicable and unmentioned; lintFindings flags COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real numbers (Spinning Axe 12-8s, Sivir E 24-18s, Stand Aside 16-12s, R 100/90/80s) and dosFull[1] rewritten to key off Stand Aside's cooldown for the Spell Shield bait.

edits.before: Q both passes through the contacts — the boomerang bills twice; stand where the return doubles.
edits.after: Boomerang's return chunks him twice and W's ricochet punishes his axe catch — Level 1 poke favors you.

edits.before: W-bounce the duo trades: the ricochet taxes his support for standing in formation.
edits.after: W-bounce taxes the duo and denies him a safe Spinning Axe catch to rebuild stacks.

edits.before: Spell shield games begin: every ability he aims is now a mana refund audition.
edits.after: Spell Shield blanks Stand Aside — his all-in bait becomes a free mana refund.

edits.before: Shove the metronome: your W clears set the lane's tempo — he farms under tower or fights your timing.
edits.after: Shove the metronome: your W clears set the lane's tempo — he still farms under tower or fights on your terms.

edits.before: On the Hunt online — the team-speed flips engages both directions; the map plays at your pace.
edits.after: Whirling Death plus full axe stacks flip the 2v2 — his all-in now threatens a real kill.

edits.before: First item spike: the ricochet shreds duos and the shove becomes weather.
edits.after: His first item spike: axes plus lethality burst hard and Blood Rush lets him kite.

edits.before: - Draven Spinning Axe: matchup-defining — Two spinning axes is lane-bully damage — stand on his pickup spots and his power halves. It governs your forward steps. - E Spell Shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Draven Spinning Axe (12-8s CD): two axes up is lane-bully damage — stand on his pickup spots and his power halves; punish the down window. - E Spell Shield (24-18s CD) spent on poke is scheduled death — save it for Stand Aside (16-12s CD). - Hold the 100/90/80s R for a real fight.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bank the E for Stand Aside (16-12s CD) — block the knockup and slow, and he loses his only real engage.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Chasing a kill off your tempo isn't the trade — the shove pays more per second across the lane than one kill skipped.

notes: Draven's Q (Spinning Axe) auto-attack reset is his combo tell (per missingInteractions) — reflected via the Stand Aside cooldown framing in dosFull[1]. suspectNames flagged 'Spinning Axes' in content.spikes[0].text as a possible wrong name, but it is just the plural of the real ability name (Spinning Axe) — no correction needed, left alone.
